To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the source of dietary protein, isoflavones extracted from soybeans, and anthocyanids extracted from elderberries do not influence the longevity of Stroke-pron Spontaneously Hypetensive (SHRPS) rats.
supplementation with soy isoflavone or anthocyanin extracts did not improve the survival time and survival rates of SHRSP rats.
the survival times of SHRSP rats fed diets supplemented with isoflavone or anthocyanin were shorter compared to the rats fed the diets without supplementation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of source of dietary proteins, isoflavones, and anthocyanids on longevity of SHRSP rats.
the effect of isoflavones, anthocyanins and dietary protein on longevity of SHRSP rats.
the influence of dietary protein and isoflavone or anthocyanin supplementation on the survival times of SHRSP rats.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dietary protein (caseins or soybean) had no effect on survival time of SHRSP rats.
the source of dietary protein did not modulate the longevity of SHRSP rats.
supplementation with extracted isoflavone or anthocyanin did not influence longevity of SHRSP rats.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
dietary isoflavones have a detrimental effect on survival time in SHRSP rats.
dietary isoflavones, but not anthocyanins or soybean protein, may modulate the lifespan and survival of SHRSP rats.
the lifespan of SHRSP rats was shortened by dietary soy isoflavone and anthocyanin supplementation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the longevity of SHRSP rats is significantly shortened by supplementation with isoflavanones and anthocyannins.
supplementation with isofavones or anthocynanins in rats with high sodium chloride consumption, a model for hemorrhagic stroke, significantly shortened the lifespan of the rats.
supplementation with isoflavanoids or anthocyanidins in SHRSP rats does not prolong the lifespan of SHRSP rats, but rather shortens their lifespan.
